verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships as an official TypeScript library (npm install better-auth). It provides a documented typed client (authClient.signUp.email, etc.) and server methods (auth.api), works with 20+ frameworks, and users praise its type-safe DX and docs. The SDK surface, however, is JavaScript/TypeScript only: a user building an iOS app found no native client and almost no guidance on writing one. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JS/TS (e.g., native mobile/Swift, other server languages), documentation for building custom clients, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s)
